wiki.title: Jared Moskowitz
wiki.extract: Jared Evan Moskowitz ( MOSS-kə-wits; born December 18, 1980) is an American politician and attorney serving as the U.S. representative for Florida's 23rd congressional district since 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served on the Broward County Commission from 2022 to 2023 and as Director of the Florida Division of Emergency Management from 2019 to 2021. Moskowitz also represented the 97th district in the Florida House of Representatives from 2012 to 2019 and was a city commissioner for Parkland, Florida from 2006 to 2012.
